scripts.test: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project ShoppingList.xcodeproj -scheme ShoppingList -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -enableCodeCoverage YES
scripts.build: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project ShoppingList.xcodeproj -scheme ShoppingList -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:release: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project ShoppingList.xcodeproj -scheme ShoppingList -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData build
